title: FHFA House Price Index — Quarterly Index with Monthly Tables (December 2026 and 2026Q4), 9:00 a.m. ET
source: EST: the same two FHFA primaries fetched direct 2026-09-06 as the proposer's own date. fhfa.gov/data/hpi (HTTP 200, 89,663 bytes) carries the row "Tuesday, February 23 | Quarterly Index (with Monthly Tables) | December 2026 and 2026Q4" as the second of twelve dated 2027 rows; the published 2026Q2 report (HTTP 200, 1,522,949 bytes, released 2026-08-25) carries the identical row on its "FHFA HPI Release Dates for 2027" appendix page above the same "9AM ET" statement. Filed estimate per this lane's no-self-confirm limit on an event discovered in-sweep, NOT because the primary is weak — it is the same forward table on which the proposer's own date was promoted to confirmed, and that precedent is one step away for whichever lane researches this id. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the fhfa-hpi-2027-01-26 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06). Two reasons it is worth a slot rather than being the same finding on a later date. First, it is the QUARTERLY edition, not another monthly: it carries 2026Q4 alongside December-2026 monthly data, so it is the first FHFA release since the 2026Q3 report (2026-11-24) to publish the quarterly series and the metro-level tables the monthlies do not, and it carries the one-step "(Previous Estimate)" restatement of whatever the proposer prints. Second — and this is what the proposer's research makes visible — it BREAKS the collision the proposer sits inside: FOMC meetings run Tuesday-Wednesday and FHFA publishes on last Tuesdays, so 8 of the last 8 JANUARY FHFA releases (2021-2028, the Fed's own posted dates) landed on FOMC day one, while the 2027 FOMC calendar has no February meeting at all (Jan 26-27, then Mar 16-17). 2027-02-23 is therefore the nearest FHFA release with neither an FOMC gate nor a year-end holiday distortion on it — the cleanest available control session for the tape work the proposer and fhfa-hpi-2026-12-29 both had to run on confounded days. It remains confounded by the Conference Board, which shares every FHFA release day by both publishers' last-Tuesday rules. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
